integrity: The proof separates the all-length induction from finite verification. Previously published minimum-attractor results are used only for comparison with the greedy profile, not as evidence for the new exact greedy set.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the standard period-doubling morphism and the Schaeffer--Shallit greedy endpoint rule. The package proves the all-length formula directly and uses finite computation only as a supporting check; it does not claim analogous formulas for other automatic words.
title: Exact greedy string attractor of the period-doubling word
